t: This is the former Simpsons of Piccadilly, at 203 to 206 Piccadilly. When it opened in April 1936 it was the largest menswear store in Britain. It was created by Alexander Simpson with the architect Joseph Emberton, and it was built to show the whole range of clothing from the tailoring firm S. Simpsons and DAKS. Its innovative construction is why it is now Grade II* listed. Emberton was an early modernist architect, educated at the Royal College of Art. The building was later bought by Waterstones, the bookshop chain.
